title: Frequently asked [questions]{.primary}
description: Can't find what you're looking for? Send us a note and we'll help.

items.title: What age groups do you teach?
items.content: We teach dancers from toddlers through teens, with classes grouped by age and experience so everyone learns alongside their peers.

items.title: Does my child need any experience?
items.content: None at all. Our beginner classes are built for first-time dancers, and we'll help you find the right level.

items.title: What should we wear to class?
items.content: Comfortable clothes that are easy to move in. Dance shoes and uniform details are shared once you're enrolled.

items.title: Can we try a class before joining?
items.content: Yes. Get in touch and we'll arrange a trial class so you can see the studio and meet the teachers.

items.title: How do I pay for classes?
items.content: Tuition is billed monthly. We'll walk you through the options when you register.
